article_title: A hurricane alters pollinator relationships and natural selection on an introduced island plant
study_system: Heliconia wagneriana x Anthracothorax jugularis, Dominica
claim_boundary: This is a one-island before/after disturbance system. The hurricane is a natural disturbance, not a randomized treatment. Floral trait matching, visitation and nectar removal are contemporary functional/selection channels; they do not by themselves establish seed-set dependence, historical island colonization effects, or a universal pollinator-loss coefficient.
